signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

pale-wash.$description: Pale Wash — Light blue surface for testimonial cards, banner backgrounds, and soft feature zones

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Primary page and card background; the default canvas

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text color for headings and body copy

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text and icon strokes; slightly softer than Ink Black for muted labels

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Hard text, high-contrast borders, and icon fills

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Hairline dividers and subtle card borders

steel.$description: Steel — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-plum.$description: Deep Plum — Dark accent for content card backgrounds and illustration strokes

orchid.$description: Orchid — Decorative purple accent for icon strokes and illustration fills

ember.$description: Ember — Warm orange accent for notification icons, illustration highlights, and callout strokes

leaf.$description: Leaf — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

butter.$description: Butter — Pale cream surface for content card backgrounds and soft highlight washes

mint.$description: Mint — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

navy-field.$description: Navy Field — Dark blue surface for inverted content cards and feature panels

charlie-display.$description: Headlines from small section titles through hero display size; exclusively weight 700, compact leading (1.03–1.33) makes even the largest size feel dense and editorial

charlie-text.$description: Body copy, UI labels, buttons, navigation, and subheadings; weight 400 is default, 500 for emphasized UI, 700 for inline emphasis; generous leading (1.45–1.71) keeps dense text airy
